title: Daily digest: Trump denies report of offering Iran san | Telangana: ACB seeks to impound KTR’s pa | Supreme Court agrees to list next week p
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: Trump denies report of offering Iran sanctions relief.
ACB has sought to impound KTR’s passport in Formula E case.
Supreme Court agrees to list next week plea to suspend CEC Gyanesh Kumar from office.
bullets_ur: Trump ne Iran par pabandiyan khatam karne ki report ko mustarad kar diya.
ACB ne Formula E case mein KTR ka passport zabt karne ki darkhwast ki hai.
Supreme Court ne agle haftay CEC Gyanesh Kumar ko ohday se hatane ki darkhwast list karne par razamandi zahir kar di.
